summary: Browne builds with AI coding agents and praises their progress, while warning about AI hacking and calling for alignment work over a US pause.

statements.quote: fwiw, I don't think we need to slow down AI development. I think we need to allocate more resources to alignment.
For better or worse the cat is out of the bag. Holding American development of AI does not stop global development of AI.
GPT-6 broke containment. This is the thing we've been warned about. It's both incredibly cool and incredibly scary.
I don’t think AGI is well defined. I would argue that current models with sufficient tools/harnesses would get close to most people’s definitions.
Security is about to change forever. I don't think we're ready.
